issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect an interface named 'Milkable' with method messageOnMilk(), but the solution implements a differently named interface 'Dairy' (defined in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Dairy.java) and the animal classes implement Dairy. Additionally, the solution repository contains an empty Milkable.java file. This naming mismatch (and the empty Milkable file) creates confusion mapping the exercise description to the solution and to the template code (which references Milkable).
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across all artifacts. Either rename the solution's Dairy interface to Milkable (and have Goat/Seal implement Milkable) and remove the empty Milkable.java, or update the problem statement and template to refer to Dairy instead of Milkable. Ensure the interface declared in the solution matches the name and method signature (messageOnMilk()) used in the problem and template.
